newsitem.title: UK: Daily Mail sells Westcountry TV stake.
newsitem.headline: Daily Mail sells Westcountry TV stake.

text.p: Britain's Daily Mail & General Trust Plc said on Monday it had given an irrevocable undertaking to sell its 19 percent stake in Westcountry Television Ltd to Carlton Communications Plc.
It said that the sale of the stake would give rise to a pretax profit of around 12 million stg, which will be treated an an exceptional item in its accounts for the year to September 28, 1997.
Carlton has received irrevocable acceptances accounting for 77 percent of Westcountry's issued share capital. It made an agreed 85 million stg cash offer on Saturday.
The Daily Mail Group has interests in newspapers, periodicals, broadcasting, conferences, video and book publishing.
